The answers below come from the project docs, as AGENTS.md directs. I didn't open the source to confirm the line numbers.

**Where it opens**
- The **Inventory** button is at `game-console.component.html:9`.
- It calls `openInventory()` at `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts:237`.
- That function runs `MatDialog.open(InventoryComponent, { data, panelClass: 'inv-dialog-panel', maxHeight: '90vh' })` at `:242`.
- The dialog shows at the bottom of the page instead of centered, because `styles.scss` lacks `mat.core()` (B-14).

**Data passed**
- The data is `InventoryDialogData = { characterId, sessionId }`, defined at `inventory.component.ts:19`.
- `InventoryComponent` receives it through `MAT_DIALOG_DATA`.

**API calls it can make** (through `GameApiService`)
| Action | Component method | Client call | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|
| Load on init | `ngOnInit` (`:53`) | `getInventory` (`game-api.service.ts:90`) | `GET /api/character/:id` (`worker/src/routes/character.ts:72`) |
| Equip or unequip | `toggleEquip` (`:72`) | `equipItem` (`game-api.service.ts:96`) | `PATCH /api/character/:id/equip` (`character.ts:93`) |
| Use potion | `usePotion` (`:96`) | `dropItem` | `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` |
| Drop | `dropItem` (`:144`) | `dropItem` (`game-api.service.ts:100`) | `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` (`character.ts:137`) |

- After loading, the dialog copies the result into `CharacterStateService.setInventory`.
- Equipping a weapon or armor unequips other items of the same type. This is display only, because combat ignores equipment (B-08).
- Using a potion rolls the heal dice in the browser (`:110-121`) and calls `dropItem` to consume one unit. HP is set locally only (`:129`) and never saved (B-05).
- Drop asks `confirm()` first and removes one unit.
- The dialog makes no shop calls. `GET /api/shop/:id` and `POST /api/shop/transaction` exist on the Worker (`routes/shop.ts`), but nothing in the UI uses them yet.
